resources.string: Violet: hawkish · Blue: dovish. Green: up · Red: down. Gold highlights key events.
%1$s · %2$s. Compare the actual value with consensus. Interpret the macro signal in the context of the indicator; above consensus does not necessarily mean a positive market impact.
%1$s · %2$s. This event has no standardized actual value or market consensus. Focus on its release time, content, and immediate market impact.
No market data was collected around this release.
Choose 2–4 assets for the Home overview · %1$d selected
Analysis develops as data arrives 1, 5, 15, 30 and 60 minutes after release.
Rule-based signals describe macro tendencies, not guaranteed asset directions.
No historical releases match the current filters.
Quotes come directly from BiQuote, Binance, and Yahoo Finance with per-asset fallback. Closed markets show their last available price.
Key stored securely on this device

HTTPS only. The key is sent only to this endpoint.
Saved. Cached event names will be translated in the background.
The key is encrypted by Android Keystore, excluded from backups, and never bundled in the APK. Use a restricted personal key with a spending limit.
Interface language applies immediately. A configured backend supplies event-name translations without a personal AI key.

Used for calendar and market-data requests (Treasury yields, quotes, candles). Leave blank to use the system network. HTTPS certificate verification stays enabled; AI and translation requests never use it.
Enter host:port without credentials or a path.
Saved. Calendar and market requests will use it.
TradingView calendar unavailable; using a backup source. Some events or published values may be missing. Check your network or calendar proxy, then refresh.
Calendar sources unavailable; showing cached data. Check your network or calendar proxy in Settings, then refresh.
Backend unreachable or rejected this device; showing cached data. Check the backend address and token in Settings.
Choose where the app reads macro data from. Direct mode uses public providers on this device; backend mode uses your own server, which owns the upstream feeds and the AI key.
Public calendar and market providers are called directly from this device. The optional proxy and your own API key apply here.
All data, event-name translations and AI analysis come from your server. No personal API key is needed.
Unable to find the Telegram bot. Check the backend connection and bot configuration; older servers may need an update.
No app can open this link. Install Telegram or a browser.
Enter a valid backend address; enable plain-HTTP access first if needed.

Request via Telegram Bot: /request_key device or /request_key general. Administrator approval is required. Device keys bind on first authorization; reinstalling or clearing app data requires a new key. Stored encrypted and excluded from backups.
Enter the API Key issued through Telegram Bot.
Backend authentication is disabled. Enable auth.enabled on the server to verify an API Key.
The backend API protocol is incompatible with this app.
The API Key is invalid, revoked, or bound to a different installation/device.
The backend could not be reached.
The access token will travel unencrypted. Only use this when you trust the network.
Fill in the backend address and access token, tap Test connection, then tap Backend to switch.
Fill in the backend address and access token first.
The cached events and your follow list are cleared, because the two modes use different event identifiers. Filter settings are kept.
Calendar source is rate-limiting this device; showing cached data. It should recover in about %1$d min.
Calendar source is rate-limiting this device; showing cached data. Try again later.
The scheduled time has passed, but no published value has been retrieved. Some events, such as speeches, have no numeric result. Fetch it again below; numerical analysis needs an actual value.
The source still returned no published value for this event.
Data release and analysis completion alerts
The 60-minute analysis for event #%1$d is ready
Public intraday data may be outside the provider’s retention window. Refresh while online; current prices are never used to fill historical gaps.

Returns use real historical candle closes: a strictly pre-release baseline and samples at or before each horizon. The table shows available windows only; -- means missing, not zero. Five-minute bars cannot measure a one-minute reaction.
Historical calendar values may be revised. These are retrospective observations, not proof of a causal or tradable reaction. Live snapshots are not used as historical prices.
Outside this source’s intraday retention period.
Historical source request failed or access was restricted. Retry after resolving the source access issue.
The release time is approximate or all-day; intraday attribution is disabled.
Some exact time windows are missing, including possible market closures or insufficient time resolution. No prices were interpolated.
Applies to newly generated briefings; already cached ones keep their content.
Structured market moves are never sent. If news context is enabled separately, only selected headlines and source metadata are added as context.
Expectation first, then compare with the moves
Two passes: the first ex-ante chain sees numbers and rules only; the second compares available moves and optional sourced news with a verdict per link.
Numbers, rules and moves in one pass
One request containing the event data, available observed moves and optional sourced news.
No usable move for this link
The AI reply was incomplete. A compact retry was attempted once. If it still fails, choose a model with a larger output limit or increase its output token budget.
Uses your configured AI endpoint to explain how this release transmits through rates, the dollar and risk assets.

When enabled, the app reads the RSS feeds below and, if separately selected, BiQuote market news. Matching titles, dates, summaries and links are sent to your configured AI endpoint. This does not apply to shared backend AI.

Off by default. When both news switches are on, fetches English US-edition headlines directly from biquote.io (Google News and Hacker News aggregation), without opening article pages unless preview is separately enabled. Keeps only title matches within 24 hours before or after the event, never later than the analysis request. This is background context, not verified event coverage or historical search.
One HTTPS RSS/Atom URL per line, up to 8 sources. Leave empty to use only BiQuote when its switch is on. Only metadata is fetched unless article preview is separately enabled.
Use up to 8 valid HTTPS feed URLs. When news is enabled, select BiQuote or enter at least one RSS URL.
News settings saved. They apply when you next generate or re-analyze.
Add an API key in Settings to generate AI analysis.
Analysis is available once the scheduled event time has passed.
No published value is available. This analysis uses event context and available market data; it does not attribute moves to a data surprise.
Ask a follow-up about this event
Rate limit reached; showing the previous analysis. Try again in about %1$d min.
Calculated on this device from the published actual and consensus values. Market returns use public one-minute candles when available and are descriptive, not investment advice.
A tighter policy path is the rule-based baseline.
An easier policy path is the rule-based baseline.
The release does not produce a directional rule signal.

Auto adjusts text and spacing to the available window width. Compact fits more content; Standard uses the original sizes. System font scaling and touch targets are preserved. Changes apply immediately and are saved.
Published value cannot be interpreted reliably
No reliable rule for this event
The cached record is missing source unit or scale metadata. Re-fetch this event’s date to recover it.
Source queried again and available data updated.
In line with expectations · No clear direction
Hawkish policy baseline: supports USD and yields; weighs on gold, NASDAQ 100 and BTC.
Dovish policy baseline: weighs on USD and yields; supports gold, NASDAQ 100 and BTC.
Inventory above forecast usually weighs on oil; below forecast usually supports oil. No other asset direction is inferred.

Single-release rule-based expectation only. Surprise thresholds are heuristic defaults, not price-move forecasts. Actual impact also depends on policy conditions, simultaneous releases and market pricing.
Single-release rule-based expectation, not actual price action
Compared with %1$s, not the previous value

Off by default. Compatible models may read only prepared event, rule, market-window and authorized news snapshots. Up to 3 tool rounds / 8 calls per stage; no arbitrary URLs or writes. Additional requests may cost more. Rejected tool parameters fall back to standard analysis.

Actual application steps and tool calls, saved locally for this event and method. This is not private model thinking. Credentials are never shown; old analyses without saved records have no reconstructed path.
Some evidence is missing; do not infer values.
Tool parameters rejected; using standard analysis.

Actual requests in sending order, with credentials redacted and model reasoning excluded. Includes messages, tool results and request settings. Saved privately on this device, excluded from backups and never uploaded; restored when you return to this event. May contain your questions and news metadata. Select text to copy manually.
No saved AI request for this event and method. Older analyses and failures before sending do not have reconstructed prompts.
This saved request log has reached the 64-request limit. Later requests are not retained.
This request body was not retained because of the inspection size or safety limit; no partial prompt is shown.
Allow AI to read article previews

Off by default. Requires news context and read-only AI functions. The model may open up to two selected news links per stage and send up to 6,000 characters of static page text to your AI endpoint. Public HTTPS only; no scripts, cookies, login or paywall bypass. Publishers can see your IP. Visits and redirects are saved in the execution path. Turning this off prevents future page reads, not existing saved previews.
Enable read-only AI function calls under AI analysis method to use article previews.
Page unavailable or blocked by preview safety limits. Do not infer article contents.
Redirect followed to the next logged URL.
Source: configured backend. No public-provider fallback.
Backend does not provide this interface; using the direct provider.
Website returned an HTTP error (see status). This is not an article preview.
Page exceeds the bounded preview size limit.
No readable static article text was found.
Google News original-link resolution failed; no publisher content was read.
